title: helianthemum nummularium var. macranthum
intro: Helianthemum nummularium var. macranthum, commonly known as Rockrose, is a flowering plant species native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Helianthemum nummularium var. macranthum are attributed to its antioxidant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and promote tissue repair. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
